describe: Light desktop avatar-picker screen. Backdrop is an illustrated pastel futuristic city skyline behind a glossy lavender floor with a glowing circular platform; not flat. Centre-left the cartoon boy in a blue explorer jacket stands on the platform (hair top y150, shoes bottom y662, jacket right x821); to his right floats the white-and-blue robot Nova holding a magnifying glass, antenna ball at y291 and its cyan hover rings ending near y598, so its box runs to y604. UI to erase: Kidsverse+ logo, 4-step progress stepper, English chip, headline plus subtitle, left avatar thumbnail rail with 'More avatars coming soon' chip, Nova speech bubble (x851-1054, y172-273), Rotate hint card, two circular carousel arrows (left circle x423-487, right circle x982-1043, both y705-763), the large right-hand outfit/hair/accessories card which runs to x1634 and y897 behind the Back and THIS IS ME buttons, and the bottom trust bar whose card bottom edge reaches y912.
